name: project-brain
description: Git-native project memory and planning: help coding agents resume from verified architecture, goals, task plans and evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Resume projects across sessions and agents with repository-based plans and evidence
interface.longDescription: Project Brain keeps a project’s state in the repository: verified architecture, the user’s goal, and a prioritized task plan designed for agents with no chat history. A local Python helper computes checkpoints, dependencies and the files to load. Agents verify inherited evidence, stay within the current request, and retain task evidence until a successful commit. Git is recommended; without Git, completed evidence stays in task files.
defaultPrompt: Set up Project Brain for this repository
Continue where the last session stopped
